method: Exact triangle intersections against actual road renderer meshes and pedestrian / grass / stair polygons; independent synthetic enclosed-island and elevation fixtures

checks.name: Crossing builder leaves the corrected input model unchanged
All paint triangles covered by visible asphalt at matching height
No paint triangle intersects paving, bus islands, grass, buildings or stair opening
Finite vertices and locally matching road elevations
Forecourt and both ends of mapped bus platforms retain crossings
Off-road fallback is removed and kerb overshoots are clipped
Tiny platform wholly within a stripe is subtracted
Concave island and small stair hole are excluded from full triangle interiors
Crossing without a visible carriageway produces no paint
Sloped elevated crossing follows actual covering road triangles

reference.position: Straight crossing centre lines and corrected pavement polygons from user screenshot 2026-10-18
reference.source: User screenshot registered to seven existing platform/island vertices; approximate reconstruction
reference.limits: Map schematic and OSM position accuracy; no measured marking survey, no claim of exact as-built paint dimensions
